Build failure missed: I shipped EditTransactionBottomSheet with androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenu(...) called by fully qualified name. That symbol is a scoped extension on ExposedDropdownMenuBoxScope, not a top-level callable. Fix was to drop the FQ prefix. Added cross-currency transfer to_amount column + edit modal field. Root cause: get_wallet_reconciliation RPC credits the destination wallet with the source amount, so a 1.5M IDR MANDIRI->BBL transfer in April was counted as 1.5M THB, inflating BBL by ~฿1.5M. Schema migration (supabase/2026-05-31_to_amount.sql) updates wallet_balances view + RPC to coalesce(to_amount, amount) on transfer-in. Web Edit modal shows Received Amount input only when source/dest currencies differ. Caveat: live RPC body was reconstructed from observed return shape — user must review SQL before applying.
